---
title: "Code"
---

Code will be linked here as the semester unfolds.

- [Linear Model Prediction Methods](predictionOLS26.qmd) — the OLS prediction toolkit (at-means and average effects; ML, delta, and simulation-based uncertainty), previewing the methods we generalize to nonlinear models. Download the [R script](https://github.com/clavedark/MLEfall26/blob/main/predictionOLS26.R) to run the examples live.
- [Binary Response Models](binarymodels26.qmd) — logit and probit from the likelihood up, with predicted probabilities, marginal effects, and odds ratios. Download the [R script](https://github.com/clavedark/MLEfall26/blob/main/binarymodels26.R); the democratic peace data it reads (`dp.dta`) is on Brightspace.

## Data

- [ITT data (`ITT.csv`)](https://github.com/clavedark/MLEfall26/blob/main/data/ITT.csv) — Ill-Treatment and Torture allegation counts by country-year, merged with World Bank (WDI) and Polity covariates; used in the `predictionOLS.R` script.
  *Source: Conrad, Courtenay R., Jillienne Haglund, and Will H. Moore. 2013. "Disaggregating Torture Allegations: Introducing the Ill-Treatment and Torture (ITT) Country-Year Data." International Studies Perspectives 14(2): 199-220. [ITT project page](https://faculty.ucmerced.edu/cconrad2/Academic/ITT_Data_Collection.html).*
